original_exact_input.reason: Use the existing native nonlinear task-capability optimizer on the same regenerated hardware. Jointly reduce dense tendon speed, stroke and reach/hold violations; do not infer success from historical target acceptance.

arguments.hypothesis: Fine control refinement still leaves competing tendon-speed, target and braking excesses. Test the mechanism hypothesis that the legal 14.1 mm routing radius reduces geometric tendon excursion for the required bending. Preserve the same sections, materials, lengths and channel topology; increased required force must be assessed by fresh bounded native reoptimization.
